question: Why did Elisha agree to help the kings?
options: Because Joram promised to destroy Baal worship
Because the king of Edom paid him
Because he respected King Jehoshaphat of Judah
Because Elijah had told him to
explanation: Elisha told Joram that if he did not respect the presence of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, he would not even look at him.
